title: Exact Primal-Dual Curvature and Constructive Lean 4 Certificates for Topological Clique Exclusion in Positively Curved Graphs
abstract: Linyuan Lu (arXiv:2611.33694v1, Nov. 2026) resolves Problem 4.1 of Song (2026) for locally finite graphs with positive Lin-Lu-Yau Ricci curvature on every edge and minimum degree >= t-1 (t >= 5): excluding TK_t forces Delta(G) <= C t^7; excluding a K_t minor forces Delta(G) <= C t^3 (log t)^(3/2) and |V(G)| <= C t^19 (log t)^9 via Hall matching; and excluding TK_t^(<=2) or K_t^(2) (under delta >= t) forces Delta(G) <= exp(C t log t), with sharp join constructions K_{t-1} join E_{n-t+1}. We provide an independent, unrefereed companion certification suite (POS-CURV-CLIQUE-CERT-1.0) comprising 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice), a strictly zero-floating-point Python verifier certifying exact Lin-Lu-Yau curvatures via primal-dual Kantorovich strong duality alongside all four proof pillars (eight submodes), 16 canonical JSON certificates (C01-C16), and 36 unit and adversarial forgery tests.
